mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a quarter indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods following the sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a surge in economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) grow faster than industrial production, it signals a demand-driven economy, which is favorable for consumer-oriented stocks, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > INDPRO growth in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPI) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a deflationary pressure, which increases the real value of debt and reduces consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the growth rate of real GDP exceeds the growth rate of the consumer price index, it indicates real economic growth outpacing inflation, which is favorable for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > CPIAUCSL growth in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
